szoveg_eredeti:
Hey everyone, I’m Nishant, founder of Smart Jelly.

I was paying for separate AI apps for dictation, meeting notes, live meeting help and agents. None of them talked to each other, so each one started from zero. I kept copying notes from one app into another just to give the AI enough context. I was paying for all of them and still doing the work of connecting them to Claude to use it as second brain.

So I built Smart Jelly: one app for all your work, with one shared memory.

Live meeting help: suggested answers, recall of past context, and fact checks against your past work

Meeting notes, with no bot joining your call

Agents that act on what Smart Jelly already knows

Every feature draws from the same memory, so a dictated email can pull from yesterday’s meeting, and agents can act on to-dos it already knows about. No more copying context between apps, and no more paying for five subscriptions.

That memory is the hardest part to get right. We spent 6 months on it, and it scores 87.6% on the BEAM-100K memory benchmark. It stays encrypted on your Mac, and you can see, correct or delete anything it remembers.

Smart Jelly is free to start. I’d love to hear which AI apps you’d replace with it, and what’s still missing for you.

Weboldal: https://smartjelly.ai/
